Card Q&A.a: No, they only get +2000 DP from this effect.
Card Q&A.q: I have a [Jesmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, and one of my Digimon has [Sistermon] in its name. Do my Digimon get +4000 DP from this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. However, Digimon affected by this effect still can't ignore the rule "Digimon can't attack on the turn that they were played".
Card Q&A.q: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "all of your Digimon may also attack unsuspended Digimon and get +2000 DP." Does this also affect my Digimon that enter the battle area in the same turn after I've digivolved into this card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Sistermon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying its play cost. Then, if [Jesmon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a Digimon with [Sistermon] in its name in play, until the end of your opponent's turn, all of your Digimon may also attack unsuspended Digimon and get +2000 DP.
